title: Sea of Illagers
description: Sail the seas, discover treasure, fight pirates and illagers, and explore a world inspired by Sea of Thieves.
body:
**RECOMMENDED MOD IS PHYSICS MOD PRO FOR WATER PHYSICS**

Sea of Illagers is an exploration and adventure modpack inspired by the pirate world of Sea of Thieves. It focuses on sailing across vast oceans, discovering hidden structures, fighting dangerous enemies, and searching for treasure in a world that feels far larger and more alive than vanilla Minecraft.

The oceans play a central role in the experience. Players can travel across the seas, explore distant islands, dive into underwater ruins, and encounter hostile pirates, illagers, and sea creatures. Exploration is heavily rewarded, with many new structures, dungeons, and points of interest scattered throughout the world.

World generation has been expanded to create a more immersive environment. Islands, coastlines, and ocean regions feel more natural and varied, encouraging players to travel further and discover new locations. Many new structures and landmarks appear across both land and sea, offering loot, challenges, and secrets to uncover.

Combat and adventure are also a key part of the pack. Illagers are more present in the world, pirate encounters can happen at sea, and dangerous areas often guard valuable rewards. Players will frequently find themselves preparing for battles while searching for treasure and rare loot.

The modpack also includes visual and performance improvements to make the world smoother and more immersive to explore. Optimization mods such as Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore help maintain good performance even with many added features.

Sea of Illagers is designed for players who enjoy exploration, ocean travel, treasure hunting, and adventure. The goal of the pack is to create a pirate-style experience where the world encourages sailing, discovery, and dangerous encounters across a living ocean.
